notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Dear Players!
New update (1.2.1211.0) is live.
Some of you have reported to us that there has been a problem while loading the chapter 45 "Rays" from time to time. It is now working fine.
Also, some Secret Digits are now easier to find. We found that the level of difficulty in this regard was too high.

Good luck in the Institute ventures...

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1176.0 (Y axis and radiation fix)
notes.content:
HELLO COMRADES!
New hotfix (1.0.1176.0) is live,
From now on if the game saves the radiation on a high level, it will be automatically lowered, so you'll be able to survive after loading the save file with the high amounts of it. 
In addition, you'll be able to invert Y-axis in the Controls menu.

Sorry for the inconvenience.
Good luck in the Institute ventures...
